bio: Long podcasts cut into vertical clips. Send me an episode, I'll edit one free.

pins.onScreen: [the strongest spoken line of the clip, checked against the audio]
pins.caption: Left: the raw 16:9 interview. Right: the vertical cut, with the frame kept on the speaker and captions timed to each word. The source is a NASA interview in the public domain. If you want your episode cut like this, DM me.
Trial: one clip for 25 €, one round of changes. You send the episode, the moment you like and where you post. Monthly packs start at 150 €. DM me with a link and I'll reply with the scope.

pins.onScreen: Send me your podcast. I'll cut one clip free.
pins.caption: Send a link to an episode you own. I pick a moment, cut it vertical with captions and send you the file. I only post it here if you say yes. You keep the clip either way.

hooks.onScreen: Nobody scrolls to the middle of your episode.
hooks.caption: So I take the moment from the middle and put it first. Before: the raw recording. After: vertical, captions you can read on mute.

hooks.onScreen: This is your podcast on a phone.
hooks.caption: A wide shot shrinks the faces to a strip in the middle of the screen. Here is the same moment reframed for vertical.

hooks.onScreen: Same interview. Watch what the vertical cut keeps.
hooks.caption: I dropped the setup and kept the answer. The raw version plays first, then the clip.

hooks.onScreen: Skip the title card. Open with the line.
hooks.caption: A title card asks people to wait. The speaker's best sentence gives them a reason to stay. Here is how I find it in a long recording.

hooks.onScreen: I cut the pause right before the punchline.
hooks.caption: Screen recording of the edit. Watch the timeline where the silence was.

hooks.onScreen: Captions should follow the words, not the sentence.
hooks.caption: Each word lights up when it's said, so people watching on mute can keep up with the speaker.

hooks.onScreen: Two people talking. One vertical frame. Who gets the shot?
hooks.caption: My rule: the camera stays on whoever is talking and cuts to the other person only for a reaction worth seeing.

hooks.onScreen: Where I look first in a long recording.
hooks.caption: Laughs, disagreements and stories with an ending. They tend to show up as louder stretches in the waveform, so I start there.

hooks.onScreen: Send me one episode. I'll send back a clip.
hooks.caption: Free, for podcasters and coaches who talk to camera. Link an episode you own in my DMs. I only post the result here with your OK.

hooks.onScreen: Before you hire an editor, watch one of your own clips.
hooks.caption: Judge the editing on your own footage, not on someone else's reel. DM me a link and I'll cut one clip free.
